Hi Priya,

I saw your opening for an Agentic UX Designer at Agentplace and want to help shape how people build and interact with AI agents.

During my time at AT Creation, I conducted usability testing and translated findings directly into improved user flows and wireframes in Figma. I also bring strong technical foundations from my B.Tech in Computer Science, which helps me bridge the gap between design and development.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates my structured approach to B2B UX and problem-solving, which you can see at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

Could we take fifteen minutes this week to discuss how my background in interface design fits your team?

Ananya

I saw the opening for a Junior Graphic Designer and Illustrator at Antal International and wanted to share my work.

My social campaign for a fashion brand demonstrated my execution skills by delivering a 15% increase in follower engagement. You can view that work in my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am based in Nagpur, ready to relocate to Mumbai, and would love to show you how my Illustrator and Photoshop skills fit your team.

Ananya
